RESUME_DATA.name: Mark Mikhalev
RESUME_DATA.about: AI Automation Engineer | Business Process Analyst | Team Lead
summary: I'm passionate about everything that makes us better, faster, and stronger. This, along with a diverse experience and an extensive skill stack, helps me deliver positive impact to any enterprise I join regardless of my role. Most of all, though, I like creating work environments where intelligent data-driven systems enable teams to focus on the work they can enjoy and thrive.

Joining IT as a copywriter in a global team, I was quickly promoted to an editor, owning the entire SEO content production cycle. After this project ended, I taught myself digital marketing and started freelancing for international clients, sharpening my skills. Then, I was offered a role in Instaon, a Belgian startup that developed a tool for generating ad copies on a proprietary LLM. This was my first experience working with AI.

Working with AI then provided me a chance to peek at the change that we are experiencing today, and gave me hope to see the second renaissance with my own eyes. Since then, I have been waiting for the moment AI makes the abundance culture a real promise for people, not sci-fi. This moment has come. Today, I help teams adapt to the new reality and apply agentic AI to drive growth.

If you want to help your team and move some things around with AI, you’re in the right place at the right time — I am open to offers. I'm looking for a team of like-minded people to build long-term relationships with and, through little feats, score big wins. I am autonomous, quick to spot areas for growth, and act on them.

You can find an outline of my tech experience below, or download my CV here. And if it feels like a good match with your wants and needs, and you want to talk or offer me a role in your project — hit one of those contact buttons on the right and drop me a line, or book a Calendly slot for a quick chat. I’ll be happy to hear from you and talk about the exciting things we can do make our lives and the world better.
